## 贡献类型 / Type of contribution

- [ ] 新增认知/素材 New insight or material
- [ ] 修正译文 Translation fix
- [ ] 事实纠错 Factual correction
- [ ] 文档/工具改进 Docs or tooling

## 改了什么 / What changed

<!-- 一句话说明 / One sentence -->

## 依据与溯源 / Sources

<!-- 素材请注明来源 URL/书名与日期，勿编造 / Cite source URL/book and date; never fabricate -->

-

## 自检 checklist

- [ ] 一次 PR 聚焦一个主题 / One topic per PR
- [ ] 事实性内容有可核对来源 / Facts have verifiable sources
- [ ] 若改了语料或标签，已运行 `python scripts/translate_graph.py` 并确认 `python query.py --en stats` 正常 / Regenerated English graph if labels changed
- [ ] 无 token/密码/私钥等敏感信息 / No secrets committed
- [ ] 愿意把自己写进 CONTRIBUTORS.md / OK to be listed in CONTRIBUTORS.md
